title: 第85章 本王的诗，你也敢抄袭？
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 翌日京都城外，左骁卫军营中。老福王巡查完军营，便回到营帐给炎文帝写奏折。而在正式写奏折之前，老福王从桌案上的书本中，将一张纸张抽了出来。纸张上写的，正是唐逸当日写给他的那首诗。这几日一直在巡查拱卫京都的军队，他一直没有时间将诗词重新誊抄，现在巡查完左骁卫，巡查任务也就完成了。给炎文帝写奏章汇报的同时，自然要将这首诗也带过去，给炎文帝也欣赏欣赏。免得狄苍那老狐狸以为只有他有小诗仙的诗词，嘚瑟个没完，现在他也有了，而且还是一首能流传于世的绝世名诗。他现在……也可以嘚瑟了。诗词而已，说的谁没有一样。“老爷，老爷，出事了，出大事了呀王爷。”然而，他刚刚提笔，管家却连滚带爬地跑了进来。老福王脸色阴沉，放下毛笔道：“什么事情急成这样？北狄打到京都了？”“不是北狄打到京都了，是唐少爷给你写的诗词出事了。”管家将手中的信封高高抬起，递给了老福王：“这是京都来的最新消息，王爷的诗词出大事了。”老福王当时就愣住了，什么玩意儿？本王的诗词还能出事？咋地，写好的诗词还能跑了？还是唐小子把诗词给用了？唐小子也不是这种人啊，本王是老了，但看人的眼光还没那么差。从管家的手中接过信件，老福福王打开看了一眼，下一秒面色呆住。信是狄苍写来的，老家伙在心中将殿试发生的事情都说了一遍，尤其是唐画在殿试上一鸣惊人，《劝谏诗》写得震撼全场。只是看了所谓的《劝谏诗》，老福王的老眼一点点瞪大。去你妈的《劝谏诗》，这是唐逸给本王写的诗词啊！竟然敢用本王的诗去参加殿试，还得了状元？找死！“《劝谏诗》？本王劝谏你老母！”“好个新科状元，小诗仙写给本王的诗，你也敢抄？”“等本王回到京都，看本王怎么整死你们父子俩！”老福王当时就不淡定了，那可是他流芳百世的诗，将来后人在赏析解读这首诗的时候，首先想到的就是他老福王是谁。妈的，现在搞成《劝谏诗》，成了他唐画垫脚石了。简直岂有此理。老福王想都不用想，就知道这首诗一定是唐画从唐逸那里抄袭的，否则两人能写出一模一样的诗？“来人，备车，本王要回京都！”老福王一巴掌拍在桌上，气得老脸通红。管家吓得脸色煞白，道：“王爷，现在还差右威卫尚未视察……”“那还不去安排本王立即去视察，巡查后直接回京都。”老福王双手撑着桌子，气炸了。管家连连点头，连滚带爬出了营帐。……翌日，唐家。唐敬在颜霜玉的伺候下正在穿衣，门房便过来禀报。“老爷，柳家老夫人在门外求见。”听到这话唐敬眼睛顿时眯了起来，正在帮唐敬穿衣的颜霜玉手也是一顿，眼底有冷意。当年，她进唐府的时候，这个老女人还帮柳如玉出过头，导致她在京都颜面尽失。现在竟然还有脸上门！呵，真当你还是当年那个威风凛凛的老女人吗？“老爷，柳老夫人这么早就来找你，恐怕是为了柳侍郎的事，看在柳姐姐的份上，老爷还是见一下吧！”颜霜玉柔声说道。丝毫没有提及昨日沈氏上门，被她羞辱的事。唐敬淡淡扫了一眼颜霜玉，看向门房道：“请柳老夫人进来，我马上过去。”门房应了一声转身离开，颜霜玉帮着唐敬整理衣襟，道：“老爷，小逸的婚事，说不定柳老夫人能帮忙呢。”“小逸不听你的话，老夫人的话，应该是听的吧！”“而且，夫君不是想要柳家那幅《书圣帖》很久了吗？这就是个机会。”唐敬一怔，瞬间就明白了颜霜玉的意思。用柳公瑾的命，逼着柳老夫人让唐逸答应联姻，同时，拿到柳家的传家宝《书圣帖》。《书圣帖》是数百年前大书法家王逸飞的大作，是让无数文人墨客梦寐以求的无价之宝。要是能趁着这机会拿到手，那就更好了。至于柳公瑾，他可以答应救。当然，只是答应而已。“夫人说得对，那今日，便交给夫人了。”唐敬抬手捏住颜霜玉的下巴，道：“你，知道该怎么做。”他很清楚这个女人有多恨柳家，给她点机会，她巴不得将柳家挫骨扬灰。颜霜玉笑容满面，道：“老爷放心，当年那老太婆让老爷丢尽脸面，今日妾身就让全部还给她。”唐敬微微颔首，松开颜霜玉道：“唐逸呢？还在西院？”提到唐逸，颜霜玉脸色难看至极，道：“不知道他闹什么，昨晚在书房折腾了一个晚上，今天天蒙蒙亮才离开的。”唐敬闻言皱了皱眉，没有说什么。这段时间，唐逸忽然莫名其妙地变得好学起来，有时间就在书房看书，这件事他是知道的，只是从不和他撞时间而已。换好衣服，唐敬带着颜霜玉来到了前院。柳老太太已经在沈氏和姜氏的陪同下，进了唐家。“呵呵，唐大人，你这唐家，还真是难进去！”唐敬还没说话，姜氏睨着走来的唐敬和颜霜玉，已经嘲讽出声。“那是，唐家现在是名门望族，可不是什么阿猫阿狗能进来的。”颜霜玉冷笑一声，反唇相讥：“再说，柳家当年不是信誓旦旦指天发誓说有生之年，不进我唐家的门的吗？怎么现在又进来了？”说到这里颜霜玉一脸我懂了的表情，目光睨着柳老夫人道：“哦，我知道了，是想要求我家老爷，帮你柳家救柳公瑾吧？”“求人还这么嚣张，看来这柳家的家教，还真让人开眼界啊！”“你……”姜氏被怼得哑口无言，脸色青白交替。柳老夫人脸色不变，只是握着手杖的手下意识攥紧，更是抬手抓住沈氏的手腕，不让沈氏反击。“见过母亲。”唐敬上前给柳老夫人见礼，笑着赔罪：“母亲别介意，霜玉心直口快，但没什么坏心思，母亲别和她一般计较。”柳老夫人笑着抬手，道：“唐大人请起，老身可承受不起这么大的礼……”“老妇今日前来，是想问一下唐侍郎，唐逸和我孙子柳文彦被抓进锦衣卫，是怎么回事？”听到这话，唐敬和颜霜玉都怔了怔。唐逸被抓进锦衣卫？还有这事？唐逸自己不就是锦衣卫吗？
content_en: The next day, outside Kyoto, in the Zuo Xiaowei barracks.After the old King Fu inspected the military camp, he returned to the camp to write a memorial to Emperor Yanwen.Before formally writing the memorial, Old King Fu pulled out a piece of paper from the book on the desk.What was written on the paper was the poem Tang Yi wrote to him that day.In the past few days, he had been patrolling the troops defending Kyoto. He had never had time to re-copy the poems. Now that he had finished patrolling Zuo Xiaowei, the patrol mission was completed.While writing a memorial report to Emperor Yanwen, it was natural to bring this poem with him so that Emperor Yanwen could also appreciate it.Lest that old fox Di Cang think that he is the only one who has the poems of the Little Poet Fairy, and ramble endlessly, now he also has one, and it is also a peerless poem that can be passed down to the world.Now... he can also whisper.It's just poetry, no matter who says it."Master, Master, something happened, something big happened, Your Majesty." However, just as he was writing, the housekeeper ran in crawling.Old Fu Wang looked gloomy, put down his brush and said, "Why is it so urgent? Beidi has reached Kyoto?" "It's not that Beidi has reached Kyoto, but something happened to the poem Master Tang wrote for you." The butler raised the envelope in his hand and handed it to Old Fu Wang: "This is the latest news from Kyoto. Something big happened to the prince's poem." Old Fu Wang was stunned at that time, what the hell?Can anything happen to my poems?Why, the poems I wrote can still run away?Or did Tang Xiaozi use poetry?Tang Xiaozi is not this kind of person. I am old, but my taste in seeing people is not that bad.Taking the letter from the butler's hand, Old King Fufu opened it and took a look. His expression was blank for the next second.The letter was written by Di Cang. The old guy recounted everything that happened in the palace examination in his heart, especially the Tang painting that became a blockbuster in the palace examination and the "Poetry of Admonition" that shocked the whole audience.Just after reading the so-called "Poem of Admonition", Old King Fu's eyes widened little by little.Fuck you "Poetry of Admonition", this is a poem written by Tang Yi for me!How dare you use my poems to take part in the palace examination and get the top prize?court death!""Poetry of Admonition"? I advise your mother!" "You are such a new champion, how dare you copy the poem written by the little poetry fairy to me?" "When I return to Kyoto, let's see how I torture you father and son to death!" Old Fu Wang was not calm at that time. It was his poem that has been immortalized for generations. When future generations appreciate and interpret this poem, the first thing they will think of is who he is, Old Fu Wang.Damn it, now it's "Poems of Admonishment", which has become a stepping stone for his Tang Dynasty paintings.This is simply unreasonable.Without even thinking about it, Old Fu Wang knew that Tang Hua must have copied this poem from Tang Yi. Otherwise, could the two of them write exactly the same poem?"Come here, prepare the car, I am going back to Kyoto!" Old King Fu slapped his hand on the table, his face turned red with anger.The butler turned pale with fright and said: "Your Majesty, we still have the right guard to inspect..." "Why don't you arrange for me to inspect immediately? After the inspection, go directly back to Kyoto." Old Prince Fu held the table with both hands and was furious.The housekeeper nodded repeatedly and climbed out of the tent....The next day, the Tang family.Tang Jing was getting dressed with Yan Shuangyu waiting on him, when the concierge came over to report."Master, the old lady of the Liu family is outside the door asking to see you." Tang Jing's eyes suddenly narrowed when he heard this. Yan Shuangyu, who was helping Tang Jing get dressed, also paused, with a cold look in her eyes.Back then, when she entered the Tang Mansion, this old woman helped Liu Ruyu go too far, causing her to lose face in Kyoto.Now there is even a face door!Oh, do you really think you are still the majestic old woman you were?"Master, Mrs. Liu came to you so early, I'm afraid it's about Minister Liu's affairs. For the sake of Sister Liu, I'd better meet you!" Yan Shuangyu said softly.There was no mention at all about Shen's visit yesterday and her humiliation.Tang Jing glanced at Yan Shuangyu lightly, looked at the concierge and said, "Please come in, Mrs. Liu, I'll be there right away." The concierge responded and turned around to leave. Yan Shuangyu helped Tang Jing tidy up his clothes and said, "Master, maybe Mrs. Liu can help with Xiaoyi's marriage.Help." "Xiaoyi doesn't listen to you, so I should listen to the old lady!" "Besides, hasn't my husband wanted the Liu family's "Book of Saints" for a long time?" Tang Jing was startled and immediately understood what Yan Shuangyu meant.Using Liu Gongjin's life, he forced Mrs. Liu to make Tang Yi agree to the marriage. At the same time, she obtained the Liu family's heirloom "Shu Sheng Tie"."Book of Calligraphy" is a masterpiece written by the great calligrapher Wang Yifei hundreds of years ago. It is a priceless treasure that countless literati dream of.It would be even better if you can take advantage of this opportunity to get it.As for Liu Gongjin, he can agree to save him.Of course, it's just a promise."Madam is right. Today, I will leave it to Madam." Tang Jing raised his hand and pinched Yan Shuangyu's chin and said, "You know what to do." He knew very well how much this woman hated the Liu family. If she was given a chance, she would be eager to crush the Liu family to ashes.Yan Shuangyu smiled broadly and said, "Don't worry, sir. That old woman made me so embarrassed, and today I will give everything back to her." Tang Jing nodded slightly, let go of Yan Shuangyu and said, "Where is Tang Yi? Still in the west courtyard?""When Tang Yi was mentioned, Yan Shuangyu's expression turned ugly and she said, "I don't know what he was doing.He spent all night in the study and left at dawn today." Tang Jing frowned and said nothing.During this time, Tang Yi suddenly became inexplicably eager to learn, and would read in the study when he had time. He knew this, but he never clashed with him.After changing his clothes, Tang Jing took Yan Shuangyu to the front yard.Mrs. Liu has already entered the Tang family, accompanied by Shen and Jiang."Haha, Mr. Tang, it's really hard to get into the Tang family!" Before Tang Jing could say anything, Mrs. Jiang looked at Tang Jing and Yan Shuangyu who were walking towards them and mocked them."That's right, the Tang family is now a famous family, and no cat or dog can come in." Yan Shuangyu sneered and retorted: "Besides, didn't the Liu family swear to heaven that they would never enter the Tang family in their lifetime? Why did they come in again now?" Yan Shuangyu had a look on her face at this point.I looked at Old Madam Liu with an understanding expression and said, "Oh, I see. I want to ask my master to help your Liu family save Liu Gongjin, right?" "You are so arrogant in asking for help. It seems that this tutor from the Liu family is really eye-opening!" "You..." Ms. Jiang was speechless and her face alternated between blue and white.Mrs. Liu's expression remained unchanged, but her hand holding the cane tightened subconsciously, and she even raised her hand.
title_en: Chapter 85 Do you dare to plagiarize my poems?
